description: Cross-platform tool to automatically synchronize Bluetooth pairing keys between Linux and Windows on dual-boot systems.
notes: BlueVein runs as a Windows background service (BlueVeinService).
1) Open an elevated PowerShell (Administrator) and register the service:

If the EFI partition is not detected automatically, set the machine-wide env var BLUEVEIN_EFI_DEVICE (volume path like \\?\Volume{xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx}\) in an elevated shell BEFORE running 'bluevein install'.
After a scoop update, re-run 'bluevein install' as Administrator so the service points to the new binary.
